description: React component for the Notifications page in a gym management system frontend. It displays notifications, allows marking individual or all notifications as read, and manages notification state and fetching logic.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Fetches notifications based on current tab ('unread' or 'all') and updates state.

methods.name: loadCount
methods.description: Fetches the count of unread notifications and updates state.

methods.name: onMarkOne
methods.description: Marks a single notification as read and reloads notifications and count.

methods.name: onMarkAll
methods.description: Marks all notifications as read and reloads notifications and count.
